# Skyhigh Security
> AI-powered Security Service Edge platform for protecting enterprise data across SaaS, web, and private applications.

Skyhigh Security provides cloud-delivered security across CASB, SWG, ZTNA, data protection, and AI governance. Its site includes product information, customer resources, support, training, and company content relevant to enterprise cloud security deployments.

## Platform and Products
- [Skyhigh SSE](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/platform/skyhigh-sse/): Unified Security Service Edge platform for SaaS, web, and private application protection.
- [Cloud Access Security Broker](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/products/casb/): CASB capabilities for visibility, control, and data protection across cloud services.
- [Secure Web Gateway](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/products/secure-web-gateway/): Web security for threat prevention, acceptable use enforcement, and data protection.
- [Zero Trust Network Access](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/products/ztna/): Secure access to private applications based on identity and context.
- [Data Loss Prevention](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/products/data-loss-prevention/): Unified DLP controls for sensitive data discovery, classification, and policy enforcement.
- [Remote Browser Isolation](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/products/remote-browser-isolation/): Isolates web sessions to reduce browser-borne threats and risky content exposure.
- [Cloud Native Application Protection Platform](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/products/cnapp/): Cloud-native security capabilities for posture management and workload protection.

## AI and Data Protection
- [Shadow AI](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/products/shadow-ai/): Discovery and governance for unsanctioned AI application usage across the enterprise.
- [AI Data Protection](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/products/ai-data-protection/): Protects sensitive data used with generative AI and AI-enabled applications.
- [Data Security](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/solutions/data-security/): Broad data-centric security approach spanning cloud services, web, and private apps.
- [Insider Threat Protection](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/solutions/insider-threat/): Detects and mitigates risky user behavior and data exfiltration scenarios.
- [Ransomware Protection](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/solutions/ransomware-protection/): Security controls aimed at preventing ransomware delivery and data compromise.

## Solutions and Use Cases
- [SaaS Security](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/solutions/saas-security/): Protects sanctioned and unsanctioned SaaS usage with visibility and policy enforcement.
- [Hybrid Work Security](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/solutions/hybrid-work/): Secures users and data across remote, branch, and on-premises environments.
- [Private App Access](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/solutions/private-app-access/): Zero trust access patterns for internal applications without traditional VPN dependence.
- [Compliance](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/solutions/compliance/): Helps enforce regulatory and corporate data handling requirements in cloud environments.
- [Threat Protection](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/solutions/threat-protection/): Detects malware, phishing, and evasive threats across web and cloud channels.
- [Managed Service Providers](https://www.skyhigh.cloud/solutions/msp/): Security capabilities and deployment models tailored for managed service providers.
